relationships.subject: Suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: Suzetrigine selectively inhibits NaV1.8 on peripheral nociceptors without the central nervous system effects associated with opioids [14,15]

relationships.subject: Suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: Suzetrigine was associated with lower unadjusted 48-hour, POD0, and discharge opioid consumption, although the adjusted 48-hour association did not reach statistical significance.

key_findings: In a retrospective spine surgery cohort (50 vs 50), suzetrigine was associated with lower unadjusted 48-hour MME (median 20.0 vs 34.0), POD0 and discharge opioid use.
The adjusted 48-hour association was not significant and pain scores and length of stay did not differ.
